scope: Broaden the open-source peer review to current released/source maturity and downstream 3D consumer route boundaries; refine existing explicit-geometry, ACIS carrier, AcDs/SAB association, and native-consumer qualification gates.

method.kind: Primary-source repository/release/issue and product-documentation research with read-only plan audit
localInspection: DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md existing S8/PAR-07, PAR-76/7AP, ACIS/AcDs, peer provenance, and repeated-record owners
Current plan already records generated local repeated-run tests for the ACadSharp #1281 pattern and LibreDWG parser-safety invariants; this pass avoided duplicate work
method.limitations: No peer artifact or native application was executed. Issue/release documentation establishes reported behavior and provenance, not a local defect or universal interoperability rule. SOLIDWORKS is proprietary and is included only as an optional downstream-consumer contract, not as open-source peer evidence.

evidence.topic: ACadSharp released artifact versus open writer/read issues
evidence.observed: The signed v3.8.0 release identifies commit 3a1c66b and reports an assembly-visibility change. Open issue #1195 reports DXF writer omission of 3DSOLID/REGION and links open ACIS writer work. Open issue #1281 provides concrete recursive comment, XDATA application-block, and clip-group read paths for its stated 3.8.0/master route.
doesNotEstablish: that the peer issue reproduces in libdxfrw
that the whole ACadSharp API or release has complete DWG/DXF semantics
that peer-specific crash thresholds are format limits
a released ACIS DXF writer route or a B-rep semantic oracle
evidence.planUse: Pin package/source identity and exact operation for any optional comparison. Reuse existing local generated repeated-run tests. Keep ACIS writer unavailable until a released route and independent identity/owner readback are demonstrated.

evidence.observed: The beta NEWS records a decompression allocation-capacity versus logical-size mismatch, invalid section-page offsets, allocation-product overflow, and a 3DSOLID block-size bounds issue, among other fixes.
doesNotEstablish: that one global byte limit covers cursor, allocation, arithmetic, graph, and work/depth safety
a universal correct bound for all DWG revisions
evidence.planUse: Retain existing PAR-14/7BE and ACIS bounded-reader owners; add only a focused generated invariant when a touched local path lacks one. Keep fuzz/sanitizer work at its composed checkpoint.

evidence.topic: FreeCAD DXF import scope and backend differences
evidence.observed: The general import/export manual describes stock DXF as 2D-only because its 3D data is proprietary; the additional-components guide distinguishes native C++ and optional legacy Python importers with different entity coverage; a maintainer response on issue #18454 states stock FreeCAD cannot read the proprietary ACIS blob.
doesNotEstablish: runtime results for any pinned Linux or Windows FreeCAD build
complete support or lack of support for every explicit 3D DXF entity
ACIS/AcDs semantic acceptance through a stock FreeCAD route
evidence.planUse: Key native qualification by exact build/platform, converter, importer backend/preferences, DXF version, and entity family. Keep explicit geometry separate from ACIS and AcDs; use CONSUMER_NOT_APPLICABLE for stock ACIS unless an exact route is shown to have changed.

evidence.topic: SOLIDWORKS DXF 3D translator as a product-specific consumer contract
evidence.observed: The 2026 guide says the DXF 3D translator extracts ACIS information into a part/assembly, does not import wireframe data, and is not a 2D-to-3D converter.
doesNotEstablish: DXF normative requirements or a particular SAB/modeler-version capability
a run or license availability in this environment
evidence.planUse: Offer only as an optional, exact-release ACIS-DXF consumer observation when already available; it cannot qualify explicit wireframe/mesh support or modern DWG AcDs and is not a required dependency or routine test.

refinedOwners: PAR-76/7AP proxy and DXF carrier handling
existing ACIS/AcDs entity-owner-payload and semantic-evidence gates
peer release/package/source provenance and repeated-record hardening
readinessRefinement: separate explicit/faceted 3D geometry, inline DXF ACIS carriers, and DWG AcDs/SAB association
bind native consumer evidence to exact platform/build, importer/backend, preferences, format version, and entity family
treat FreeCAD stock ACIS as not applicable unless its exact route changes and is verified
keep SOLIDWORKS as an optional commercial consumer observation, never open-source peer or required test
use source-authored identity/owner/geometry expectations and reserve semantic body metrics for a genuine independent ACIS route
